prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset: one production game ability icon, isolated RGBA PNG, square 1024x1024 composition, actual transparent background.
Input 1 is subject/concept reference only. Inputs 2 and 3 are current game icons and control rendering style: bold clean dark outlines, chunky simplified volumes, three clean cel-shaded levels, smooth continuous solid color blocks. Their orange/gold/green colors do NOT apply; use the supplied project palette.
The user wants a concise simplified icon, not a detailed illustration. Design for immediate readability at 64 pixels. Large primary shapes, sparse interior lines, no speckles, grunge, hatching, mottled patches, tiny fragments, texture or photoreal shading. All hard-surface components have flat uniform color regions with controlled highlights.
Keep entire silhouette and trails inside the canvas with about 8 percent transparent margin. No text, letters, numbers, watermark, logo, badge, decorative frame, drop-shadow plate, background scenery or checkerboard pixels. No collage or multiple variants. Produce ONE new icon.
Subject: ONE very simplified multi-barrel Gatling gun pointing diagonally toward upper right, inspired by input 1, but drastically reduce details. A compact chunky blue receiver, one simple round ammo drum, and one cluster of four to six thick parallel barrels with clearly visible large muzzle openings. Two or three short blue firing/speed streaks ahead of the muzzle communicate increased attack speed. NO grip lattice, NO screw heads, NO hoses, NO ammunition belt or floating bullets. Dominant steel blue #6AA4BE and deep blue #274E61; restrained teal blue effects; dark outline. No green, orange or purple.
Project sRGB palette: #1A182F, #274E61, #6AA4BE, #0A6F73, #0D9099, #FEE4D9. Use these as the base colors; antialiasing and shaded transition pixels may derive from them. Broad surfaces should use only three distinct shade levels, no airbrushed gradients.
Output: actual transparent-background PNG, no baked white/black backdrop.
